title: CLOCK GEARS RATIO & SPEED CHALLENGE
shortDesc: Clock Gears Ratio & Speed Challenge tests your mechanical deduction. Calculate gear ratios and tooth mesh interactions.
description: Clock Gears Ratio & Speed Challenge is a challenging HTML5 puzzle game designed to sharpen your cognitive and problem-solving skills with intuitive controls and progressive level difficulties.
instructions: Analyze the gear train mechanism and select the correct gear ratio and rotation speeds to complete each clock level objective.

faqs.q: How do you solve Clock Gears?
faqs.a: Follow the interlocking gear teeth from driver gear to driven wheel, multiplying or dividing ratios to find the final rotational speed.
